title: Expectation under a pushforward density
statement: Let $m,n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho$ be a probability density on $\bbr_2^m$, let $L:\bbr_2^m\to\bbr_2^n$ be any map, and let $g:\bbr_2^n\to\bbr$. The expectation of $g$ under the pushforward of $\rho$ by $L$ equals the expectation under $\rho$ of the function $y\mapsto g(L(y))$.
